**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Recheck memory before Start-VM**

When the workstation has >=14 GiB at `create_vm` but drops below the floor during JIT config generation or seed attachment, this is the only new guard that runs; the pilot then creates a GitHub JIT runner and reaches the `start_vm` verb, where `Start-VM` can still fail with the same 0x8007000E condition. Because the controller calls `New-ControllerJitConfiguration` between `create_vm` and `start_vm`, add the same floor check in `start_vm` or just before JIT registration if the remediation is meant to defer host-memory pressure instead of creating and cleaning up another registration.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
